======================================================================
Ideas credited (no files or code copied)
======================================================================

Two community ports of pstack for other runtimes informed the design of this
package. Both are MIT licensed. Their files, prose and code are not part of
this package: the TypeScript sync engine, guards and extension are written
for oh-my-pi.

michael-denyer/pstack-claude (Copyright (c) 2026 Lauren Tan, Michael Denyer)
  - the fork registry (a recorded list of intentionally changed paths with a
    reason) and the sync tooling around it;
  - the panel rules: at most five seats, no two seats on the same model,
    "diversity reduced: single vendor" when the seats share a vendor;
  - the rule that every guard ships a must-trip fixture beside its must-pass
    fixture.

hieusats/omp-pstack (Copyright (c) 2026 Lauren Tan)
  - a pstack package for oh-my-pi laid out for native discovery: skills,
    agents and rules at the package root, task agents dispatched by name as
    lanes.
